title: The Princess
author: Tennyson, Alfred Tennyson, Baron
description: "The Princess" by Baron Alfred Tennyson Tennyson is a serio-comic blank verse narrative poem published in 1847.
longDescription: A princess forswears men and establishes a women's university where males are forbidden.
